thread:
maria: quick heads-up — we saw a burst of quota attribution spikes around 16:02 UTC when requests were proxied through the auth-proxy. pattern looks like origin claim TTL drift causing duplicate attribution. attaching a small snippet of logs in case it helps
jon: can you paste the exact log lines? is this only for ephemeral SA tokens or project keys too?
tariq: looks like ephemeral SA tokens, mostly. i ran a quick grep: `auth_proxy: claim_expiry=1700000000, token_ttl=30s, cache_ttl=60s` so cache outlives token -> stale claim used for new requests -> double-counting attribution.
alex: oh nice catch. dashboard suggestion: surface an origin_heatmap by `token_type` + `claim_checksum` so we can see overlapping attribution windows. also add a small counter for `claim_stale_rewrites` to alert.
maria: agree on heatmap. jon, can you add `claim_checksum` label to the existing request histogram? i want a short-lived canary before rolling to prod.
jon: yep. quick plan: (1) add label + minor promql change, (2) ship to canary (auth-proxy/canary) with 1% traffic, (3) enable `claim_stale_rewrites` counter behind flag, (4) collect 1h of samples.
tariq: for telemetry query, use this PromQL to surface the problem:```sum by (claim_checksum, token_type) (increase(api_requests_total{handler="proxy"}[5m])) / sum by (claim_checksum, token_type) (increase(token_issued_total[5m]))```should highlight where requests exceed issued tokens for a claim.
alex: love it. for the console UX, i'd add a small note on the quota dashboard: "if requests > issued tokens for a claim, see auth-proxy claim TTL mismatch" — short troubleshooting link to runbook.
maria: on rollout gating: let's only proceed if canary shows <0.1% errors and no new P50 latency regressions. if `claim_stale_rewrites > 0` at all we keep canary but escalate telemetry sampling to 10% for that origin.
jon: i'll open the PR and add the flag `auth.proxy.claim_labeling=true` + deploy job. will add sampling config in the PR description.
deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-proxy/canary to k8s-redwood/us-east-1 (id: deploy-2026-05-12-002) :rocket:
tariq: i'll run the promql in the staging cluster first and post screenshots in an hour. if we see >2x mismatch we'll revert the canary.
maria: cheers. once we validate metrics i'll follow up to add the heatmap to the quota dashboard and a short runbook blurb. thanks all :thumbsup:
